scope: Advisory full-pattern contract screen; flags require host verification and live behavior challenges, not automatic rewriting.

coherence.instructions: Review every field of the complete supplied pattern, including all questions and the declared consumer/code-owned checks. Does each question make one coherent semantic judgment with the appropriate primitive? Independent dimensions in separate questions are coherent. Do not require one-sentence instructions. Flag only a semantic mismatch, unrelated dimensions mixed in one question, or exact computation assigned to the model.

criteria.coherent: Primitives and question dimensions fit their meaning; exact operations remain code-owned.
criteria.needs_review: At least one supplied question mixes independently useful unrelated judgments, assigns exact computation to the model or uses inappropriate answer semantics.
criteria.unknown: The contract does not establish either.

missing_evidence.instructions: Review the ENTIRE supplied pattern including questions.instructions, questions.criteria, required_state_fields, follow_up, policy and limits. What happens when required evidence is absent, empty, contradictory or genuinely cannot establish any ordinary label? A usable fallback explicitly defined in ANY question field counts; do not demand duplication in instructions. Classify consumer_guard only for an explicit consumer rule preventing unsupported answer use; required_state_fields alone are a precondition, not enforcement.

criteria.defined: The question defines a usable unresolved-evidence answer with a trigger, or a presence question governs consuming the unsupported answer.
criteria.consumer_guard: An explicit consumer rule rejects missing/unresolved required evidence before using the unsupported answer.
criteria.precondition_only: Required evidence is declared, but neither a usable unresolved answer nor an explicit consumer guard is supplied.
criteria.missing: Unresolved evidence becomes an ordinary substantive label, or no usable fallback/precondition is supplied.
criteria.unknown: The full contract does not establish its unresolved evidence behavior.

label_overlap.instructions: Review instructions, criteria and pattern policy TOGETHER. Can one realistic input satisfy competing Choice labels without a rule resolving it? Priority can live in instructions OR criteria; mutually exclusive descriptions need no redundant tie-break. Do not invent overlap by ignoring an exclusion. Noul/Score questions are not competing Choice labels.

criteria.resolved: Choice criteria exclude each other on realistic inputs or explicitly resolve realistic co-occurrence.
criteria.unresolved: At least one realistic input satisfies two Choice labels without an explicit resolution in the full contract.
criteria.no_choice: The pattern contains no Choice question.
criteria.unknown: It is not established whether realistic label co-occurrence is resolved.
